title: UAE Emergency News
summary: I’m announcing that I created a Telegram channel that delivers Korean translations of breaking war news from 20 media outlets every three minutes, for the safety of my colleagues and acquaintances in the UAE.
content:
Together with Jeon, I created a Telegram channel for my colleagues and Korean acquaintances living in Abu Dhabi. It translates and delivers local breaking news related to the war in Korean every three minutes.

https://t.me/uae_emergency_news

If you have family or acquaintances in the UAE, please share this with them. I sincerely hope everyone stays safe.

It refers to the following list of 20 sources.

| #  | Source             | Description          |

| 2  | The National       | UAE local      |
